title: Evaluation datasets from captured records
one_line: Turn real production calls into versioned test sets you can re-run.
verified_against: Promotion, versions, diff, jsonl export/import run for real on @capture records (temp HOME). inspect export loaded and scored by inspect-ai 0.3.291 (json_dataset + `inspect eval --model mockllm/model`); lm-eval export loaded and run by lm-eval 0.4.13 (`lm_eval --model dummy --include_path`); both logs re-parsed by briefcase.integrations.evals. Not run: the native sanitizer path (extension not built here; covered by a stub in tests), real provider records, a real model.
